advices.diagnosis: The measurements indicate a pure data class (anemic domain model) with high cohesion in terms of data storage but low behavioral cohesion. advices.risk_notes: No refactoring is recommended. The class is a valid data holder in the domain layer. Attempting to lower LCOM4 by adding behavior would violate the 'data_class' intent and potentially introduce unnecessary complexity.
